decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - London Borough of Hounslow objects to the planning application on the grounds that the development would encroach on, and be an intrusive element in the Gunnersbury Triangle Nature Reserve, which is identified as having regional and metropolitan importance. If, notwithstanding this objection, the development is permitted, it is requested that the landscaping of the development adjoining the nature reserve should have a high proportion of native species. It is also requested that L.B.Ealing should consider enhancement of the nature reserve by means of a legal agreement in the event of planning permission being approved, and ensure protection measures as outlined in the report by Waterman Environmental in the submitted design statement.
description: Demolition of existing showroom and repair workshop, mixed use redevelopment to provide new five storey building comprising of B1 offices (1.075sqm) and 50 (1 & 2 bedroomed flats) and basement car parking (OUTLINE application with approval sought for siting)  -Consultation from other borough.
